immutable: Source evidence. Do not edit, reformat, re-serialise or regenerate this file: the test that consumes it binds the recorded sha256, and a bridge record that has been rewritten is no longer the thing that happened.
units: Residuals and overlaps are exactly as the capture wrote them. The residual is in input coordinate units, whose physical meaning is not established; the overlaps and fractions are dimensionless.
what: One relocalization bridge record, copied byte-for-byte out of a real capture. It is the recorded false acceptance this repository's current bridge policy exists because of, kept here so the policy can be regression-tested against the exact evidence that was accepted rather than against a reconstruction of it.
why: On 2026-08-28 this bridge was accepted with every internal number healthy - residual 0.515, a 1.50x refined runner-up margin, matched fraction 1.00 - and the placement it chose was wrong. Its own record said coarse_unambiguous: false, and a genuinely different refined candidate covered more of the model (0.598) than the winner did (0.483). Current policy refuses an ambiguous coarse search before anything measured afterwards, so re-judging this record today must refuse it.
